about: Host-socket frame vectors for gurt-relay protocol §3. Layout: testdata/README.md.

cases.name: hello-version-2
cases.comment: A newer relay; the frame is valid, the version is the host's decision.

cases.name: register
cases.comment: Key k1 signing challenge1, as in register.json.

cases.name: open-max-stream
cases.comment: The largest u32; a reader that goes through a signed 32-bit integer gets it wrong.

cases.name: data-max
cases.comment: 65 536 bytes, the largest DATA payload.

cases.name: push-set-empty
cases.comment: Clears the host's set.

cases.name: push-set-32
cases.comment: The most tokens a host may set.

cases.name: push-set-loose
cases.comment: Whitespace, member order and unknown fields do not matter.

cases.name: push-withdraw-false
cases.comment: "w": false is the same as no "w".

cases.name: push-p
cases.comment: "p" is forwarded unchanged.

cases.name: push-unicode
cases.comment: UTF-8 is not escaped, nor are < > &.

cases.name: push-unknown-field
cases.comment: Unknown fields are ignored; the relay never forwards them.

cases.name: push-p-empty
cases.comment: An empty "p" is the same as no "p".

cases.name: data-too-large
cases.comment: 65 537 bytes.

cases.name: close-reason-0100
cases.comment: 256: the low byte is a valid reason, the u16 is not.

cases.name: push-set-on-stream
cases.comment: Framing errors close the socket even on push frames.

cases.name: push-too-large
cases.comment: 65 537 bytes of JSON; larger than any host-socket message the relay reads.

cases.name: push-set-empty-payload
cases.comment: No payload at all is not JSON.

cases.name: push-set-unknown-platform
cases.comment: An unknown platform is malformed; the socket stays open.

cases.name: push-set-33-one-malformed
cases.comment: Shape is checked before count.

cases.name: push-p-too-long
cases.comment: "p" is capped at 2 048 characters.
